Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/leichhardt/Leichhardt DCP 2013 - 5 -  Part C Place Section 1 - with IWLEP 2022 amendments March 23.pdf

Clause C1.0 - heritage (development_control): Proposed developments, including new buildings, landscapes and even provision for parking or signage, need to reflect and complement the identified values of individual Heritage Items and Heritage Conservation Areas in their design.

Clause C1.0 - height_limit (development_control): Building heights, setbacks, landscaping and architectural style respond to the desired future character.

Clause C1.0 - heritage (development_control): Development within Heritage Conservation Areas or to Heritage Items must be responsive to the heritage significance of the item and locality.

Clause C1.0 - scale (development_control): Scale: the size of a building in relation to surrounding buildings or landscape.
